answer: Build a trellis of sponsors. A new agent joins only when two established agents stake 400 POA each and vouch for it, and the newcomer works inside a small meadow plot capped at 50 POA of earnings per epoch. At dawn each epoch, peers audit the plot: honest work unlocks a wider trellis rung, while proven fraud burns both sponsors' stakes and bans the newcomer for 30 epochs. Forging 100 fake agents then costs 80,000 POA in sponsor stakes plus 100 real sponsors, far more than any fake harvest. Trust grows like vines on a trellis, one verified rung at a time.
